text.p: The following are the reports carried by Estonia's newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Consultations over a new coalition government continue. Prime Minister Tiit Vaehi and Centre Party leader Edgar Savisaar held intensive talks at the weekend.
- A drunken member of the Defence League, a volunteer home-guard force, shot and wounded three men after a quarrel in a bar.
- The council of the small opposition Moderates Party said Vaehi should resign rather than try and form a new coalition.
- A hand grenade exploded in a house in the southern town of Tartu, damaging four flats.
- Estonian law and order forces and their counterparts in the Russian Pskov region will exchange liaison in future to enable a better exchange of information in crime-fighting.
